fusions.name: Two-Pronged Jab
fusions.desc: Jabs the target twice, dealing 3 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Either Way
fusions.desc: Looses 2 bites in diverging directions, each dealing 10 damage and stunning what it hits for 1 second.

fusions.name: Double Back
fusions.desc: Darts you 3 tiles forward, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Second Guess
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
